noThreads: No side threads yet — type below to start one
emptyTitle: Ask on the side without disturbing the main session
emptyBody:
Type below to start, or use /btw in the main composer; add -new to start a fresh thread.
The side agent's work streams here live (text / tools / thinking / permissions).
emptyTranscript: No messages yet — send the first question to start streaming.
thinkingDefaultHint: Do not override the model's own default thinking level
thinkingFollowHint: Follow the main session's effective thinking level
thinkingSheetHint: Controls the side subagent's model reasoning level. Existing threads switch in place without replacing the agent.
stoppedThreadHint: Send below to rebuild and continue this thread (it inherits prior conclusions).
inputPlaceholderNew: Type a question to start a new side chat…
sentInterruptToast: Interrupted the current answer and sent
willSwitchModel: Will switch this thread's model to {{model}} in place (takes a few seconds)
willSwitchThinking: Will switch this thread's thinking level to {{thinking}} in place (takes a few seconds)
modeSheetHint: Modes come from the active provider; different models and CLIs may expose different options.
willSwitchControls: Will update this thread's mode or feature settings in place (takes a few seconds)
providerLocked: Provider locked: {{provider}} (set when the thread was created; start a new thread to use another provider)
willRebuild: Will rebuild and continue this thread (inherits prior conclusions)
willNewThreadChanged: Will start a continuation thread (inherits this thread's context)
modelsSheetHint: Existing threads can only switch models within their own provider (in place); new threads can pick any provider.
settingsFallbackHint: Open Settings → Plugins → ByTheWay to configure
stopIneffective: Cancel did not take effect in 5s — open the tab and stop it there

reg.slashBtw: Side chat: ask from the main session's context (continue current thread)
reg.slashBtwNew: Side chat: start a new thread
reg.slashFork: Clone this session into a new parallel session

set.newDefaultsHint: The model defaults to following the main session. Thinking, modes, and feature settings come from the active provider/model and default to the main session or provider defaults.
set.defaultModelHint: follow = follow the main session; or set provider/model (e.g. codex/gpt-5.5)
set.contextHint: How side chats learn about the main session. Default: linked by agent id — the side agent reads the latest progress via Paseo tools on demand.
set.actionDigestHint: Include a recent tool-action digest in the snapshot (changes first)
set.attachMainHint: Create side agents as children of the main session (easier cleanup and discovery)
set.titleModelHint: follow = same model as the thread; or provider/model (e.g. codex/gpt-5.5)
set.aiTitlesHint: Generate a short title after creation (manual renames are never overwritten)
set.expCancelHint: Try the MCP helper cancel first; fall back to stop-in-tab after 5s
set.aboutDesc: Side chats that never disturb the main session: live execution stream, threads, agent-linked context.
